article.story: NEW YORK -- — Thomas Batties II's 24 points helped Harvard defeat Columbia 79-54 on Saturday. Batties added five rebounds for the Crimson (8-8, 1-1 Ivy League). Robert Hinton scored 17 points while finishing 8 of 12 from the floor. Ben Eisendrath went 6 of 9 from the field to finish with 13 points, while adding five assists and five steals. Kenny Noland led the way for the Lions (12-4, 1-1) with 10 points. Columbia also got nine points and three steals from Connor Igoe. Miles Franklin also recorded eight points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
